```{r ZMEExamples, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Zero-modified exponential distributions.", fig.width=8, fig.height=4, out.width="90%"}


p <- 0.7
x.rate = 2

x <- seq(0, 3,
         length = 100)
y <-  p * dexp(x, 
               rate = x.rate)
                     

par( mfrow = c(1, 2))

####

plot(y ~ x,
     type = "l",
     axes = FALSE,
     ylim = c(0,
              max( c(y, 1 - p) ) ),
     xlab = expression(italic(X)),
     ylab = expression(Prob.~"function"),
     main = expression(bold(atop(Mixed~distribution,
                                 "zero-modified"~model))),
     lwd = 3)
abline(h = 0,
       col = "grey")
axis(side = 1)
axis(side = 2,
     at = c(0, 
            1 - p),
     las = 2)
box()

points(x = 0, # Included
       y = 1 - p,
       pch = 19)

# Explanatory labels
arrows(x0 = 0.35,
       x1 = 0,
       y0 = 0.17,
       y1 = 1 - p,
       length = 0.15,
       angle = 15)
text(x = 0.35,
     y = 0.17,
     pos = 1,
     label = expression(Pr*"("*italic(X)==0*")" ) )


arrows(x0 = 1.5,
       x1 = 1,
       y0 = 0.8,
       y1 = dexp(x = 1, 
                 rate = x.rate) * p,
       length = 0.15,
       angle = 15)
text(x = 1.5,
     y = 0.8,
     pos = 3,
     label = expression( Exponential~distribution) )




###

p <- 0.65
x.rate = 4

x <- seq(0, 3,
         length = 100)
y <-  p * dexp(x, 
               rate = x.rate)

plot(y ~ x,
     type = "l",
     axes = FALSE,
     ylim = c(0,
              max( c(y, 1 - p) ) ),
     xlab = expression(italic(X)),
     ylab = expression(Prob.~"function"),
     main = expression(bold(atop(Mixed~distribution,
                                 "zero-modified"~model))),
     lwd = 3)
abline(h = 0,
       col = "grey")
axis(side = 1)
axis(side = 2,
     at = c(0, 
            1 - p),
     las = 2)
box()

points(x = 0, # Included
       y = 1 - p,
       pch = 19)




p <- 0.25
x.rate = 2

x <- seq(0, 3,
         length = 100)
y <-  p * dexp(x, 
               rate = x.rate)
axis(side = 2,
     at = c(0, 
            1 - p),
     las = 2)
lines(y ~ x,
      lwd = 3,
      lty = 2)
points(x = 0, # Included
       y = 1 - p,
       lwd = 3,
       pch = 4)

legend("topright",
       lwd = 2,
       pch = c(19, 4),
       lty = c(1, 2),
       bty = "n",
       legend = c(expression(italic(p)==0.65~and~lambda==4),
                  expression(italic(p)==0.25~and~lambda==2)))

```
